claims.quote: Described from Manipur state, northeastern India and also known from neighbouring Nagaland state with type locality 'On Ukjhang sang Road, 1 mile from Yaribuk, Manipur, Assam, India'.

regions.name: Manipur river basin
regions.quote: Most habitats lie within the Manipur river basin, including the tributary Iril and Khuga drainages, and the Dikhu watershed in Nagaland.
